name: Kawasaki F7 / F8 Bison
engine: 174 to 346 cc air-cooled two-stroke single, Superlube oil injection, points
intro: Kawasaki's early-70s enduros. Two-strokes with oil injection, points and rotary valves on some models.

B: It has Kawasaki's Superlube oil injection, not premix. Keep the oil tank filled with two-stroke oil and check the pump cable and lines.
It runs points ignition. Clean, gap and time the points before you chase a carb problem.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
